verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented Zulip policy, setting, or commitment about whether user data is used to train AI models. Self-hosting and export tools (zulip-docs-8, zulip-docs-6) are related data-control arrangements, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit. The privacy-posture axis applies to a hosted chat service, so missing evidence means none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
